name: Glass folder
oneLiner: one brand-colour glass folder on a dark lit stage: a glass cursor clicks it, it turns to three-quarter and real cards fan out of it, a live player of the brand's own video in the centre
bestFor: vertical openers and teasers for creators, founders, agencies and media brands with their own video and faces; a hero shot inside a longer film
motion: a cursor glide and click, one power3.inOut turn from frontal to three-quarter, cards fanning on back.out, one sheen across the glass, a slow sine turn in the hold

sound.ui: click on the cursor and each player press, whoosh on the turn, pop as the cards rise and the title lands, shimmer on the sheen, tick on each small word
